department: Department of Biology (Ottawa-Carleton Institute of Biology)

deadline.value: International applicants apply by 1 February for Fall entry.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Name a professor who agrees to supervise you when you apply; you must be accepted by a thesis supervisor to register.
supervisor.quote: To register, you need to have been accepted by a thesis supervisor. | The supervisor’s name is required at the time of application.

funding.value: Doctoral admits (including international) with an admission average of 8.0/10 (A-) or higher get an admission scholarship of at least CA$72,000 over four years; others rely on supervisor or other funding. International students must also show proof of funding (supervisor stipend plus awards or trust funds).
funding.quote: Have an admission average of 8.0/10 or higher. | This financial support offers a minimum value of $72,000 over a period of four (4) years

also.quote: International students must provide proof of financial support: i.e., a stipend provided by a supervisor as well as a combination of awards and/or trust funds.

entry_route.value: Master's in biology (or equivalent) with 75% (B+). Students already in the uOttawa master's can fast-track to the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Have a master’s degree in Biology (or equivalent) with a minimum average of 75% (B+).

notes: Joint uOttawa-Carleton institute; your supervisor's home university awards the degree.
